    CVE-2026-102785YOOtheme Pro — unauthenticated RCE

    Headline drop: unauthenticated RCE through the Joomla extension's image handler — a PNG/PHP polyglot webshell written to a public media directory. Exploited in the wild per Unit 42; fixed in 5.0.53.
